g.text: All 16 local contrasts shown. Full pointwise 95% paired source-group intervals; 64 groups in each independent test cohort.
Representation / learner contrast, not a pure memory effect: at 1 s, duplicated public features alter LR regularization without extra information.
LR: logistic regression. HGB: histogram gradient boosting. The statistic uses the maximum of six fixed checkpoint scores.
